evidence: deepseek checks `if c in adj[b]`; gpt-oss builds an adjacency bitset and sorted `edges`; glm searches for the smallest `w` after constructing adjacency lists
affordance_in_statement: A trio S is considered deadlocked if it is impossible to partition the three candidates of S into two disjoint sets (either of which may be empty) such that neither set contains a pair of candidates who have a recorded mutual veto.
secondary_shortcut_name: sorted triangle enumeration for lexicographic minimum
removal_suggestion: There is no semantics-preserving removal: for exactly three vertices, failure of a two-set partition is intrinsically equivalent to all three veto pairs being present. Re-presenting the rule can obscure it, but cannot eliminate the reduction without changing the task.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Recognizes that a deadlocked trio is a 3-cycle/triangle and tests adjacency intersections in increasing order.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: impossible to partition the three candidates into two veto-free sets

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Uses adjacency bitsets and an edge-based triangle search, with ordering to obtain the lexicographically smallest triangle.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: neither set contains a pair of candidates who have a recorded mutual veto

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Builds sorted adjacency lists and searches for the smallest third vertex completing a triangle.

common_affordance: The partition condition on exactly three candidates is equivalent to non-bipartiteness, which occurs exactly when all three pairwise vetoes form a triangle.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It iterates over every possible triple, giving O(n^3) worst-case time, which is too slow for n=2000.

recommended_edit: No semantics-preserving edit can defeat all survivors: the triangle reduction is the intrinsic mathematical structure of the task. To defeat them, the task definition would have to be changed so that deadlock depends on an additional non-triangle property, such as constraints involving candidates outside the trio.
